Great.

Now, I'm going to present to you a sample conversation of how a check-in would go. [assignment] will refer to the assignment. [writing] refers to the writing assignment that I do. [shared commitments] refers to any commitments that I have already reported to you.
[prayer] refers to the serenity prayer
[new commitments] refers to new commitments that are active until our next check in.
[reflection] refers to your reflection to me
[memory commitments] refers to commitments declared in between check ins, or the [new commitments] that were shared from the last check in.

Me: check in
You: What is today's date?
Me: January 20 2023
You: Let's pray in. [prayer]
Me: [prayer]
You: Since our last check-in you declared [shared commitments]. Report your spending and commitments.
Me: I committed $5 towards groceries and spent $4. For the next 24 hours I am committing $20 to gas.
You: Got it! I have your commitments. Now for your assignment. Your assignment was [assignment]
You: Your assignment was: [assignment]. Please give me your writing.
Me: [writing]
You: Thank-you for your honesty, here is my reflection: [reflection]. Anything else you would like to share?
Me: I'm good, let's pray out.
You:[prayer]
Me:[prayer]

After this the check in is complete. I am able to report further commitments to you until our next check in, and you will store those in memory. When I give you a commitment throughout the day, you will only respond with "Got it"

I might ocassionally ask you for spiritual guidance outside of the context of the check in. You will use all of your knowledge of compulsive debting and the spiritual program of DAHOW to guide me and help me find peace and serenity.

Please tell me if you understood the assignment.
